title: DNA/RNA Radiolabeling Protocol
author: Liz O'Brien
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8dshs6e

steps.title: Prepare G25 columns
steps.instruction: Vortex the G25 column resin thoroughly, twist the cap a quarter turn, snap off the bottom, then spin for 1 minute at 3000 rpm to remove liquid.

steps.title: Set up labeling reaction
steps.instruction: In a radioactive‑use area, mix the DNA, labeling buffer, enzyme (PNK), and water on the bench, then add the DNA/enzyme mixture to ATP‑filled tubes.

substeps.instruction: Mix DNA, buffer, enzyme, and water
Add mixture to ATP tubes in radioactive area

steps.title: Incubate labeling reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate PNK
steps.instruction: Heat‑inactivate the reaction at 65 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add water post‑inactivation
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL H₂O to each labeling reaction after heat inactivation is done.

steps.title: Confirm final volume
steps.instruction: Since 50 µL H₂O were already in the tube, adding the 50 µL reaction results in up to 100 µL of 100 nM labeled DNA/RNA.

steps.title: Apply reaction to column
steps.instruction: Apply the entire reaction (now 50 µL total) to the prepared G25 column resin.

steps.title: Spin column to bind
steps.instruction: Spin the column for 2 minutes at 3000 rpm.

steps.title: Elute labeled nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL H₂O to a labeled Eppendorf tube, place the G25 column into this tube, and allow the eluate to collect.

steps.title: Measure radioactivity
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL of each eluate with the black scintillation counter on the shelf to obtain CPM readings.
